messages.subject: Re: Rserve/FastRWeb does not respond (successfully) after some time without any obvious reason
messages.subject_clean: Rserve/FastRWeb does not respond (successfully) after some time without any obvious reason
messages.body_plain:
Harry,

On Apr 11, 2014, at 6:52 AM, dirty-harry-ha at gmx.de wrote:

> Hello R-users,
>  
> I use Rserve and FastRWeb for serving a web application.
> After starting FastRWeb everything is fine and it runs like I would expect it.
> 
> I would expect it running 24/7 ...
> but after some (unspecific) time it does not respond (successfully) any more without any obvious reason,
> and I get different errors like the following ones, if I check it with some simple scripts like main.R or info.R provided by the FastRWeb package:
> Evaluation failed with error code -7
> Unable to connect to Rserve (result=-1, socket:unknown socket error 2)
> Unable to connect to Rserve (result=-2, socket:unknown socket error 2).

2 =  "No such file or directory", so it seems as if something/someone removed the socket from the FS. If that happens, can you check whether the socket still exist at that point?


> But the Rserve process is still running (most of the time) when I stop it by "sudo killall -i Rserve" to restart it again afterwards.
> Does anyone has an idea what might be the reason for that problem?
> (I may provide more information, but I do not know what information might be important according to that problem.)
> 
> Moreover I have another problem according to restart FastRWeb after the above mentioned problem occured:
> When I try to restart FastRWeb, the restart process breaks most of the time with the message "Killed" during the process of loading the required packages. This break does NOT occur always at the same step of loading the required packages!
> After rebooting the server FastRWeb does start and run without any problems (for some time).
> Does anyone has an idea what might be the reason for that problem?
> 

It's hard to tell without logs, but it seems that your VM has some kind of resource limit and the whole VM gets clogged up by something else such that you can't even start Rserve anymore. Do you get any logs for the reason why Rserve gets killed by the system? Together with the issue above it seems like something really suspicious is going on in your VM, I suspect it's not really related to Rserve itself. Does your VM have enough memory?

FWIW we run FastRWeb 24/7 without restarts for many months without problems on Ubuntu 12.04 machines.

Cheers,
Simon

messages.subject: Re: How to properly use multiple R connections?
messages.subject_clean: How to properly use multiple R connections?
messages.body_plain:
Vlad,

using parallel connections is safe as long as you have separate connection objects for each.

Can you provide the exact code of what you're doing? Or at least a minimal reproducible example? Also which platform do you run Rserve on? Note that Windows doesn't support parallel connections due to its limitations.

Cheers,
Simon
